## ModelSlot

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

Stored model-slot preferences. A slot is configured only when model is
present; sanitized level-only records can be retained but resolve as unset.
A thinking level alone does not select an implicit fallback model.

```ts
export interface ModelSlot {
    cacheRetention?: CacheRetention;
    model?: {
        provider: string;
        id: string;
    };
    thinkingLevel?: ThinkingLevel;
}
```

**Member index** (including nested object members; inherited members are defined in the linked base types):

- [cacheRetention](#modelslot-cacheretention)
- [model](#modelslot-model)
- [model.provider](#modelslot-modelprovider)
- [model.id](#modelslot-modelid)
- [thinkingLevel](#modelslot-thinkinglevel)

### ModelSlot cacheRetention

Native Pi preference. Absent leaves Pi/environment behavior unchanged.

```ts
cacheRetention?: CacheRetention;
```

### ModelSlot model

Configured model coordinates; provider and id must be supplied together.

```ts
model?: {
    provider: string;
    id: string;
};
```

### ModelSlot model.provider

```ts
provider: string;
```

### ModelSlot model.id

```ts
id: string;
```

### ModelSlot thinkingLevel

Optional thinking level used with this slot's configured model.

```ts
thinkingLevel?: ThinkingLevel;
```
